Experienced professional with progressively responsible experience in child care, Family Resource Center, residence life or social work, programming, policy analysis, community support and/or student services.

The Graduate and Family Housing Family Resource Coordinator is responsible for using knowledge and skills as a seasoned, experienced Student Services professional, performs the full range of duties and responsibilities within a Student Life specialization. Assesses situations and determines appropriate action or referral. Works independently under general supervision to provide information and interpretation of complex policies, procedures and regulations. Identifies and responds to student needs for programs, services, and crisis intervention. Incumbent will track national trends in parenting student needs to develop curricular responses to those needs. Serves as a member of the Graduate and Family Housing and Student Housing Emergency Response Team.

Under the general supervision from the Family Resource Center Manager, the Family Resource Center Coordinator serves as a member of the Graduate and Family Housing Residential Life team. Assists in the development of community through connecting with residents, supervising student staff, programming/curriculum development and implementation, advising groups, managing projects, and administrative duties. This is a visible and important position in developing the Graduate and Family Housing communities. Overall responsibilities include developing programs and services to support and create belonging among parenting students and their families, selection, training, supervision, and evaluation of student staff, oversight of parenting programs, budget management, counseling and referring students (individually and in groups), committee work within housing and with other student service offices; and working cooperatively with other campus agencies such as SOAR Center, UCI Police Department (UCIPD), Counseling Center, and Health Services. The Family Resource Coordinator will assist the Family Resource Center Manager in the development and expansion of all programs and services managed out of the Family Resource Center within Student Housing.

Per the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (CANRA), this position has been identified as a Mandated Reporter. The selected candidate will be required to report known or suspected child abuse or neglect as defined by CANRA and will be required to sign a Statement Acknowledging Requirement to Report Child Abuse prior to commencing employment. CANRA Penal Codes, and related definitions, requirements, and responsibilities may be obtained here: http://www.leginfo.ca.gov/cgi
